open_points.subject: execute_trial_case
open_points.text: - execute_trial_case: [VALIDATION_ERROR] When the SandboxResult reports stop_required, the execution is recorded first with its crashed outcome and detail_code, and then StopRequiredError is raised so that nothing further runs in the request; this capability does not infer stop from detail_code.
open_points.other_text: - execute_trial_case: [BEHAVIOR] MUST trust the writer invariant that every member of TrialCase.expected_outputs, when present, is a StoredValuesRef: add_trial_case is its only writer and stores every authored expected value or file fixture as such refs, while a captured case has expected_outputs None. The outcome is the sandbox outcome of the same name; a succeeded execution is passed when the case has no expected outputs or every output's digest equals the expected one — every digest compared is content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes: a value output's its canonical bytes, a file output's the bytes of its FilePayload content or of each FileListPayload contents item in list order — the same digest its FileFacts later records as content_digest —, both computed from what the sandbox returned, and an expected output's the value_digest of its StoredValue, read with read_records, for a value and for each file alike; the outcome is decided before any output is written, so no output is read back from the store —, a many file output equal only with the same length and equal digests position by position, and output_mismatch otherwise; a succeeded value output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant makes the outcome contract_violation.
open_points.question: When stop_required is true but SandboxResult.outcome is not crashed, must the recorded outcome be forced to crashed, or must it remain the outcome corresponding to SandboxResult.outcome?
